items.title: 9.3.1.2 Customer Surveys and Focus Groups (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3.1.2 (PDF 213), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Customer Surveys (gahakon se sawalnama): survey bohat se customers se maloomat jama karne ka taqatwar zariya hai. Yeh online, phone par ya aamne saamne kiya ja sakta hai. Survey mein aam taur par sawalon ki ek series hoti hai jin ke customers jawab dete hain, aur is se un ki pasand, behaviors (khareedne ki aadaton) aur demographics (umar, jins, aamdani jaisi maloomat) ka qeemti data milta hai.

Misal: bakery kholne se pehle aap mohalle ke logon mein survey baant sakte hain ta ke pata chale ke woh dukaan mein kaunsi baked cheezein dekhna chahte hain, din ke kis waqt khareedna pasand karte hain aur kitna kharch karne ko tayyar hain. Is se aap apne products aur business hours (dukaan khulne ke ghante) target market ki zaroorat ke mutabiq dhaal sakte hain.

Focus Groups: focus group mukhtalif qisam ke chand logon ka chhota group hai jinhein kisi product, service ya idea par detail se baat karne ke liye ikattha kiya jata hai. Asal maqsad customers ki raye aur soch (attitudes) ko poori tarah samajhna hai.

Misal: bakery ke focus group mein log mukhtalif breads aur pastries chakhte hain, phir apni pasand, na-pasand aur behtari ke suggestions (mashwaron) par baat karte hain. Is se qeemti qualitative data milta hai. Yeh feedback products ko behtar banane aur customers ki zarooratein gehrai se samajhne mein bohat kaam aata hai.

blocks.prompt: Focus group kab survey se behtar hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Jab jawab ginne ke bajaye yeh samajhna ho ke log aisa kyun mehsoos karte hain, maslan naya product chakh kar un ki detail wali raye lena.

items: Survey: bohat se log, tay shuda sawal. Focus group: chand log, detail se baat cheet.
